items.docs:
**Spaces method and path for this operation:**
get /s/{space_id}/api/fleet/agent_status/data
Refer to [Spaces](https://www.elastic.co/docs/deploy-manage/manage-spaces) for more information. Get the data streams that an agent is actively sending data to.

[Required authorization] Route required privileges: fleet-agents-read.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number

params.name: perPage
params.description: Number of results per page

params.name: kuery
params.description: A KQL query string to filter results

params.name: showAgentless
params.description: When true, include agentless agents in the results

params.name: showInactive
params.description: When true, include inactive agents in the results

params.name: withMetrics
params.description: When true, include CPU and memory metrics in the response

params.name: showUpgradeable
params.description: When true, only return agents that are upgradeable

params.name: getStatusSummary
params.description: When true, return a summary of agent statuses in the response

params.name: sortField
params.description: Field to sort results by

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort order, ascending or descending

params.name: searchAfter
params.description: JSON-encoded array of sort values for `search_after` pagination

params.name: openPit
params.description: When true, opens a new point-in-time for pagination

params.name: pitId
params.description: Point-in-time ID for pagination

params.name: pitKeepAlive
params.description: Duration to keep the point-in-time alive, for example, `1m`
